audience: HR and people teams that look up users, contracts, departments and offices in Woffu

useCases.title: List the users of the company and open one
useCases.text: List the users of the Woffu company. Open one user by its UserId to read the name, company, department and status fields.

useCases.title: Review the contracts of one employee
useCases.text: Open one user by its UserId. List the employment contracts of that user.

useCases.title: Read the departments and offices of the company
useCases.text: List the departments of the Woffu company. List the offices, or work centres, of the same company.
